topic.original: AI systems are unavoidably unsafe in known and unknown ways.  Systems that lack of a safety supervisor function which anticipates, detects and remediates AI harms constitutes a prima facie design defect. The Safety Supervisor function must be a combination of specific document technical features to address known safety issues and organizational practices and processes to address unknown safety issues.
